name: GeoSuggest GEO & AIO Toolkit
author: iamrahulsngh

sections.description:
GeoSuggest helps AI assistants understand and cite your content.

  • AI crawler control. Allow or block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more, with a live robots.txt preview.
  • llms.txt and llms-full.txt. Generated automatically from your content.
  • Direct answer box. Write the 40 to 60 word answer AI assistants quote first.
  • FAQ and How-to schema. Structured data without extra plugins.
  • Entity signals. Organisation and author details (sameAs, job title, topics).
  • GEO score. A live score in the editor and a site-wide audit with the biggest fixes first.
  • AI traffic dashboard. See visits from AI assistants and crawler hits. Data stays on your site.
  • Markdown copy of each page. Every included page also has a clean .md version, such as /my-post.md, for AI tools.
  • Article schema. BlogPosting structured data for posts, with author details, unless another SEO plugin already adds it.
  • Weekly AI traffic email. A short summary of AI visits every week. Off by default.
  • Write answers with AI (optional). Draft a direct answer with Claude or ChatGPT using your own API key.

Works alongside any SEO plugin.

External services

The “Write with AI” button is optional. It only works after you add an API key in the plugin settings. When an editor clicks the button, the post title and text are sent to the provider you chose: Anthropic (Claude) at https://api.anthropic.com or OpenAI (ChatGPT) at https://api.openai.com. The provider returns a draft answer, which the editor can change before saving. Nothing is sent otherwise.

Privacy policies: Anthropic https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy and OpenAI https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it, then open GEO in the admin menu.
